title: Lexical Complexity Prediction and Lexical Simplification for Catalan and Spanish: Resource Creation, Quality Assessment, and Ethical Considerations
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not benchmark any aspect of faith or religion. Its focus is on creating and analyzing datasets for lexical complexity and simplification.
findings: No findings related to religion were reported in this paper. The ethical analysis section focused on issues related to disability and sexual orientation, but not religion.
